title: QDD biped skill spec (schema_version 2; 1 still accepted)
description: A short whole-body skill that starts and ends in the standing pose. Schema 2 adds jumps (contact schedule with flight phases, flight limits, pchip interpolation, policy rate). Structural schema only: tasks/qdd_skill.py validate_spec is the authoritative gate (it also checks timing, the pose-dependent knee limit, joint / torso speeds, torso tilt and height, flat parallel soles and static balance). Safety limits, terminations, observations, actions and domain randomisation are fixed by the task template and cannot be set here.

schema_version.description: 2 = current (contact / flight / policy_rate_hz / pchip); 1 = no flight, 50 Hz

duration_s.description: Length of the motion; the last keyframe is at t = duration_s.

settle_s.description: Return-to-stand phase after the motion: the standing pose is held and rewarded.

interpolation.description: minjerk = smooth, zero velocity at every keyframe; pchip (schema 2) = monotone cubic, velocity continues through monotone runs (push-off).

support.description: both_feet: both soles stay flat on the floor the whole time.

keyframes.description: Times strictly increasing, >= 0.2 s apart; first at t = 0 and last at t = duration_s, both the standing pose (no joints_deg / torso).

reward_weights.description: Optional; penalties are magnitudes (applied negative). Defaults in tasks/qdd_skill.py REWARD_WEIGHT_BOUNDS. flight_* / landing_load / toe_first / takeoff_speed / joint_power apply to skills with a flight phase only; feet_contact then weights the contact schedule.

policy_rate_hz.description: Schema 2: policy rate of this skill (the ONNX policy_io states policy_dt_s; the controller runs the skill at this rate).

reference_table.description: Schema 2: feed-forward reference table in skills/ (written by a tool such as the robot repo's analysis/hop_reference.py, never by hand): joint position / velocity targets, torque feed-forward and residual scale every dt. The low level plays it back and the policy learns a residual around it.

contact.description: Schema 2 contact schedule: phases {t, feet} from t = 0 ('both'), alternating 'both' / 'none' (flight), ending 'both'. Each flight 0.06..0.3 s and close to the ballistic time of flight.com_rise_m; take-off >= 0.5 s; last touchdown >= 0.5 s before duration_s. Around a flight (take-off - 0.15 s .. touchdown + 0.25 s) joints may move up to 20 rad/s, keyframes may be 0.02 s apart and the flat-sole checks are skipped in the air and landing window; torso pitch limit 40 deg.

flight.description: Schema 2, required iff the contact schedule has a flight: target and limits of the jump (robot repo docs/jump-feasibility.md).

com_rise_m.description: Target CoM rise above the take-off height [m] (take-off speed sqrt(2 g h)).

max_takeoff_speed_mps.description: CoM vertical speed limit (motor bus current / LM5069).

max_landing_load_mg.description: Landing load per foot [m g] above which the landing cost is strong (ankle motor radial limit 4.7 m g).

toe_first.description: Reward touching down toes first (ankle plantar-flexed).

t.description: Seconds; >= 0.2 s after the previous keyframe (0.02 s around a flight).

torso.description: Optional cross-check of the pose the joints give with flat soles (pitch + = nose down, roll + = left side up, height of the torso origin above the floor; standing = 0, 0, 0.354). Not allowed in a flight / landing window. Pitch up to 30 deg (40 deg for a skill with flight).

joints_deg.description: Absolute joint angles in degrees; unlisted joints keep the standing value (hip_pitch -22.5, knee 45, ankle_pitch -22.5, others 0). A side-less name sets both legs mirror-symmetrically (yaw / roll negate on the right leg). Ranges are the joint ranges minus 3 deg.
